title: Esther Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Esther 4: Mordecai mourns, and Esther decides to go to the king: "if I perish, I perish."

questions.text: What did Mordecai do when he found out all that was done?
questions.explanation: Mordecai tore his clothes, put on sackcloth with ashes, and went into the city wailing loudly and bitterly.

answers.text: Went straight in to see the king
Put on sackcloth with ashes and wailed
Fled from the city of Susa by night
Wrote a letter of protest to Haman

questions.text: Why did Mordecai come only up to the king's gate?
questions.explanation: No one was allowed inside the king's gate clothed with sackcloth.

answers.text: The gate was locked at night
Haman's guards stood at the gate
He was too weak to go further
No one in sackcloth was allowed inside

questions.text: What did Mordecai do with the clothing Esther sent him?
questions.explanation: Esther sent clothing to replace his sackcloth, but he didn't receive it.

answers.text: He didn't receive it
He gave it to the poor
He put it on at once
He tore it to pieces

questions.text: Which of the king's eunuchs did Esther send to Mordecai?
questions.explanation: Esther called Hathach, one of the king's eunuchs appointed to attend her, and sent him to Mordecai.

answers.text: Hegai
Harbona
Hathach
Shaashgaz

questions.text: What did Mordecai give Hathach to show to Esther?
questions.explanation: He gave him the copy of the writing of the decree given out in Susa to destroy the Jews.

answers.text: The signet ring of the king himself
A copy of the decree to destroy the Jews
A letter written by Haman to the king
A page from the book of the chronicles

questions.text: What was the law for anyone who came to the king in the inner court without being called?
questions.explanation: Whoever came uncalled was to be put to death, unless the king held out the golden scepter.

answers.text: Death, unless the king held out the golden scepter
A fine of silver paid to the treasury
Being sent out of the palace for good
Waiting at the gate for seven days

questions.text: How long had it been since Esther was called to come in to the king?
questions.explanation: Esther said, "I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days."

answers.text: Seven days
Forty days
Thirty days
One year

questions.text: Complete Mordecai's words: "Who knows if you haven't come to the kingdom for ..."
questions.explanation: Mordecai asked, "Who knows if you haven't come to the kingdom for such a time as this?"

answers.text: the sake of your father's house
the honor of the king
a reason you cannot see
such a time as this

questions.text: What did Esther ask the Jews in Susa to do for her?
questions.explanation: She asked them to fast for her, neither eating nor drinking three days, night or day.

answers.text: Pray for her at the king's gate
Fast for her three days, night or day
Send gifts to the king on her behalf
Leave the city of Susa at once

questions.text: What did Esther say about going in to the king against the law?
questions.explanation: Esther said she would go in to the king, which was against the law: "if I perish, I perish."

answers.text: "The king will surely spare me."
"Let Mordecai go in my place."
"If I perish, I perish."
"I will wait until I am called."
